title: IDÉE — Cubist Painted Collage style preview (slate café wall)

scenes.title: Still life locks into one connected system
scenes.purpose: An idea becomes a connected system: the guitar, bottle, glass and table edge, each drawn from several viewpoints, lock into one compressed Cubist picture plane against a dark café wall.
visuals: Stationary dark slate café wall (#2F3833) with seeded Canvas 2D brush grain
Static left column in paper tone #ECE4D0: IDÉE, 'an idea becomes', 'a connected system', with an ochre rule
Guitar from two views: frontal body (ochre), side band (gray), hatched umber overlap, soundhole, neck, strings, bridge
Bottle from two views: gray profile with a clipped plain-ruled paper passage, and a paper-toned top-view disc with shoulder and mouth rings
Glass from two views: paper profile with stem and foot, plus the rim ellipse seen from above
Table from two views: ochre top plane and gray front edge, umber where they overlap; ochre/gray/umber wall planes anchored to the table corner
Printed-paper fragment reading LE SYSTÈME, and a PAPIER COLLÉ label card
Every facet has a seeded Canvas 2D scumble texture rotated to its plane, with #332E29 outlines

beats.development: Each view group slides from its authored per-view offset (up to 130 px) into registration and fades from 0.35 to full opacity.
Bottle view swap: the profile facet shifts left and fades to 0.55, while the top-view facet scales from 0.86 to 1 and comes forward to full opacity.
Readable hold: the composition is fully settled.

findings: Motion is complete by 2.0 s, ahead of the 2.7 s settle requirement.
The headings are static paper-tone text on the slate wall (about 9.6:1 contrast), so they are readable in every frame.
justifiedHolds: A 1.0 s hold from 2.0 to 3.0 s lets viewers read the registered still life and its copy.

notes: Refresh: scene-dependent dark slate café wall replaces the warm #DED5BB swatch; the facet pigments (ochre, gray, umber, paper) and #332E29 outlines are kept.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json has 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame evidence was applied.
STYLE.json has no preview_recipes, so the primary implementation is demonstrated.
No Blender was used. Tools: Paper.js (build-time geometry), SVG, Canvas 2D, GSAP.
Typography: Didot declared via @font-face local() with a Georgia fallback; Futura with Helvetica Neue/Arial fallbacks.
